# bc7enc

Small BC7 block encoder by Richard Geldreich Jr., from
https://github.com/richgel999/bc7enc_rdo (retrieved 2026-10-17).

- `bc7enc.h` Git blob: `8794c15d5cd928d9ab9040dee39f18382d461f63`
- `bc7enc.cpp` Git blob: `2ff358a4574bdc4112cac53cd712d5a38887727d`

Unmodified upstream sources. Dual MIT/public-domain license is included at the end
of the implementation. Used only by the offline material importer. The complete
upstream repository and its build are not required.
